description: Batch event imports posted to the Mixpanel /import endpoint. /track is vendor/mixpanel. /engage is vendor/mixpanel-engage. /groups is vendor/mixpanel-groups. Auth is a header or basic auth, not a JSON field.

params.name: strict
params.description: Mixpanel documents `strict=1` so the batch is validated and failed events are named in the response.

params.name: event
params.description: Mixpanel documents the event name as required on every imported event.

params.name: properties
params.description: Mixpanel documents the properties object as required. `time`, `distinct_id`, and `$insert_id` ride inside it.

params.name: properties.time
params.description: Mixpanel documents `time` as required Unix seconds or milliseconds since epoch.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds or milliseconds since epoch, as an integer.

params.name: properties.distinct_id
params.description: Mixpanel documents `distinct_id` as required. An empty string is allowed for events that are not tied to a user.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `distinct_id` you use elsewhere for this user, or an empty string when there is no user.

params.name: properties.$insert_id
params.description: Mixpanel documents `$insert_id` as required so `/import` can be retried without double-counting.
params.fix_hint: Send a unique id per event, at most 36 alphanumeric or hyphen characters.
